
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/CKExp/p/19319722" title="发布于 2025-12-08 09:09">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">腾讯云EdgeOne Pages托管Blazor Wasm</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>对于Blazor WebAssembly，因其特殊性，可以直接部署成站点，浏览器下载后，在浏览器中直接运行。总想薅点大厂羊毛，能够免费部署这类应用，搜寻一方了解到，像是Github Page、Azure Static App、腾讯云EdgeOne等都可以白嫖来部署静态站点。如此，结合部署过程，进行记录一番。</p>
<h2 id="edgeone-pages">EdgeOne Pages</h2>
<p>腾讯云提供的EdgeOne Pages等同于Github Pages服务，近日从测试版升级为了正式版，并且仍然有免费套餐，可以部署静态站点和基于Next.js的全栈项目。</p>
<p><a href="https://edgeone.cloud.tencent.com/pages/document/162936635171454976" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://edgeone.cloud.tencent.com/pages/document/162936635171454976</a></p>
<h2 id="新建项目">新建项目</h2>
<p>此处新建一个Blazor WebAssembly(Standalone)的项目，注意是非Blazor WebApp类型的。此处上传到Github中，因此Github中提前建好仓库，默认克隆到本地好了，开始创建项目。</p>
<p>执行创建命令</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain">dotnet new blazorwasm -n EdgeOnePagesBlazorDemo -f net8.0&nbsp;
dotnet new sln -n BlazorDemo
dotnet sln add .\EdgeOnePagesBlazorDemo\
</code></pre>
<p>增加gitignore忽略bin/obj等文件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cs">dotnet new gitignore
</code></pre>
<p>执行代码推送到Github仓库中，代码部分完事。</p>
<h2 id="构建与部署">构建与部署</h2>
<p>为了将站点资源打包后部署到EdgeOne Pages，需要做一步打包工作，借助于Github Actions完成打包。部署方式上有两种方案：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>从EdgeOne Pages上配置由其主动拉取。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>使用EdgeOne提供的CLI，将打包后的资源上传到EdgeOne Pages。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="流水线构建">流水线构建</h3>
<p>可以直接借助Github Pages一样的构建方式，新建yml来构建Blazor Wasm项目。在Github仓库页面上，点击顶部Action菜单，创建工作流，搜索.NET，点击配置按钮</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090501007-464170823.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
更换默认文件名，具体名字随意</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500669-1730080731.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
文件内容如下，各步骤见第一个参考文档内描述</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain"># This workflow will build a .NET project
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-net

name: Deploy to Github Pages

on:
&nbsp; push:
&nbsp; &nbsp; branches: [ "main" ]
&nbsp; pull_request:
&nbsp; &nbsp; branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
&nbsp; deploy-to-github-pages:

&nbsp; &nbsp; runs-on: ubuntu-latest

&nbsp; &nbsp; steps:
&nbsp; &nbsp; - uses: actions/checkout@v4
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Setup .NET
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dotnet-version: 8.0.x
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Publish DotNet Blazor Project
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; run: dotnet publish ./EdgeOnePageBlazorDemo/EdgeOnePageBlazorDemo.csproj -c Release -o release --nologo
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Commit wwwroot to Github Pages
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@3.7.1
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; BRANCH: gh-pages
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; FOLDER: release/wwwroot

</code></pre>
<p>保存开始执行流水线构建，正常构建完毕后，构建结果会存储在gh-pages分支中。再后续对main分支的改动都会触发流水线，并更新到gh-pages分支。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500678-1321389358.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
如果Github Action运行中出现了403的错误信息，为配置中缺少权限。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500686-583607149.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
进入到仓库设置页，更改为具备读写权限。重新触发流水线构建。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500743-1614527382.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
切换到gh-pages分支，可以看到构建后的资产文件。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500830-1333010742.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="拉取部署方式一">拉取部署(方式一)</h3>
<p>进入到EdgeOne Pages(<a href="https://console.cloud.tencent.com/edgeone/pages" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://console.cloud.tencent.com/edgeone/pages</a>)。点击创建项目，导入Git仓库，选择Github仓库，进入到配置项目页。此处分支选择上一节构建完毕的结果分支gh-pages分支。如果想要绑定自己的域名，但是没有备案，则区域设置选择全球可用（不含内地）。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500641-1725566473.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
无需其他设置，点击开始部署即可。等待大概一分钟，部署完毕。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500848-1599721901.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
默认分配了有效访问时间的预览域名，也可以绑定自己的域名。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500645-1824413626.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
为了实现EdgeOne Pages自动拉取产物部署，可以设置一个钩子，在Pages项目设置页中，新建钩子并拿到最终的API地址。在github仓库设置中新建Webhook。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500826-59984811.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="推送部署方式二">推送部署(方式二)</h3>
<p>如上提及方式为EdgeOne Pages主动拉取资产，EdgeOne Pages提供了CLI，能够实现推送方式，这种方式下，不需要通过Webhook实现两端同步。但是需要一个EdgeOne Pages的凭证配置到Github仓库设置中。创建一个API Token。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500976-1265192473.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
回到Github仓库设置中，找到机密与变量设置，Actions下创建一个机密</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500693-1432130908.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
key为EDGEONE_API_TOKEN，值为从EdgeOne Pages中新建的Api Token值。</p>
<p>修改原有流水线构建文件，直接构建到部署。此处部署新项目名为edgeonepagesblazordemopush，以区分方式一，其内容如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-plain"># This workflow will build a .NET project
# For more information see: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/automating-builds-and-tests/building-and-testing-net

name: Deploy to EdgeOne Pages

on:
&nbsp; push:
&nbsp; &nbsp; branches: [ "main" ]
&nbsp; pull_request:
&nbsp; &nbsp; branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
&nbsp; deploy-to-edgeone-pages:

&nbsp; &nbsp; runs-on: ubuntu-latest

&nbsp; &nbsp; steps:
&nbsp; &nbsp; - uses: actions/checkout@v4
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Setup .NET
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; dotnet-version: 8.0.x
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Publish DotNet Blazor Project
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; run: dotnet publish ./EdgeOnePagesBlazorDemo/EdgeOnePagesBlazorDemo.csproj -c Release -o release --nologo
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Setup Node.js
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; uses: actions/setup-node@v4
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; with:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; node-version: '22.11.0'
&nbsp; &nbsp; - name: Deploy to EdgeOne Pages
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; run: npx edgeone pages deploy ./release/wwwroot -n edgeonepagesblazordemopush -t ${{ secrets.EDGEONE_API_TOKEN }}
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; env:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; EDGEONE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EDGEONE_API_TOKEN }}

</code></pre>
<p>如此一来，直接推送代码后，自动进行流水线构建并推送到EdgeOne Pages。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500795-1710678139.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
在EdgeOne Pages中可以看到新项目，同样预览没问题。后续任何代码变更自动更新EdgeOne Pages站点。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1133736/202512/1133736-20251208090500990-116774740.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
效果预览地址</p>
<p><a href="https://edgeone.viatorlife.top/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://edgeone.viatorlife.top/</a></p>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>通过腾讯云EdgeOne Pages承载blazor wasm项目，薅其静态站点服务，本文借助github及action完成，同样可以借助其他平台完成，总归是利用平台的构建与EdgeOne Cli推送。</p>
<h2 id="参考">参考</h2>
<p><a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/blazor/host-and-deploy/webassembly" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/blazor/host-and-deploy/webassembly</a></p>
<p><a href="https://edgeone.cloud.tencent.com/pages/document/180252837825597440" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://edgeone.cloud.tencent.com/pages/document/180252837825597440</a></p>

</blockquote>
